sources.title: Khipu Consensus — BFT 3-of-4 multi-party signed agreement
sources.snippet: Khipu Consensus — BFT 3-of-4 multi-party signed agreement The category SZL invents: multi-party-witnessed AI. Turn a chain of governance "organs" into a Byzantine-fault-tolerant multi-signature agreement. Each witness signs an action hash with its own ECDSA-P256 key. ≥ 3 valid allow signatures over the same action ⇒ canonical. 2-of-4 or fewer ⇒ rejected.
